import sys

MODULO = 1000000007

n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
m = 2 * n
f = [[0] * (m + 2) for _ in range(m + 1)]
f[0][0] = 1
ans = 0

for i in range(1, m + 1):
    f[i][0] = f[i - 1][1]
    for j in range(1, m + 1):
        f[i][j] = (f[i - 1][j - 1] + f[i - 1][j + 1]) % MODULO
    if i % 2 == 1:
        for j in range(1, m - i + 1, 2):
            ans = (ans + f[i][j]) % MODULO

print(ans)
